decision_summary.summary: Observed facts: the workflow failed at node marker_detect with TARGET_NOT_FOUND (read_planning_brief); event-0022 records 'no detection from inference service' for scene all_scenes on the 50 um ION image; the latest 1024x1024 ION frame (sha256 6e7175ae...) contains no confidently detectable marker at 50 um HFW. Event history shows the marker was milled at the origin stage position (event-0012, mill_cross_marker) and the stage was then deliberately moved away (event-0016, marker_stage_hide), leaving the stage at x=75, y=26 (device snapshot). The most likely cause is that the marker lies outside the narrow 50 um field after the stage-hide move, not that the marker is missing. Unknowns: the exact off-frame marker offset; whether it lies within a 400 um field. Strategy: repeat detection at the same 50 um conditions would add no information, so instead (1) acquire a wide 400 um ION search frame (contract maximum), (2) detect the marker there with a relaxed threshold 0.3 to tolerate its smaller apparent size at low magnification, (3) move the stage to bring the detected marker (src_ref from action 2) to image center (dst 0,0 um; threshold 5 um fixed), then (4) acquire a fresh 50 um ION frame and (5) verify the marker at the workflow's declared threshold 0.5, matching the required postcondition target_visible(marker, hfw=50 um). Numerical choices: 400 um maximizes search coverage within the 4 remaining recovery images; 0.3 search threshold widens acceptance for a small low-mag target; 0.5 verify threshold matches the original workflow threshold; dst (0,0) centers the marker well inside the +/-25 um half-field of the 50 um view. The captured safety snapshot shows the manipulator parked, no collision, stage idle; ACE rechecks clearance before each executed move.
